scientific_integrity: The asymptotic proof is mathematical. Finite checks are only computational consistency tests, not certification of a limit. No novelty asserted for the pre-existing deterministic scalar minima.
scientific_limitations: Fixed integer r and square Cartesian complete-product graphs; not uniform for growing k or unbalanced rectangles. Standard low-degree Poisson techniques and the rook occupancy identity are previously known. Publication-priority risk from unindexed random incidence-graph literature remains; no independent audit.
title: Paired Poisson thresholds for random total domination on rook graphs
